**How to falsify it:** Discovery of pathogenic variants in EDARADD with a dominant-negative effect or variants in distinct genes causing these phenotypes independently would falsify this shared loss-of-function mechanism. _(variant: gnomAD analysis showing a high frequency (>1%) of pathogenic loss-of-function variants in EDARADD in the general population.)_
